text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(Whoa, what is this pace?!
Don't rush, don't rush, don't rush...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(When caught in a raging torrent, all the more reason
――one must not move carelessly.)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
(If there's a fleeting chance to seize the era—
In a single instant!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
ââ!! I see through it!
Take THIS!!" his/her tone

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —!? Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No Reason takes the lead!
Is No Reason out in front now?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The winner is No Reason!!!!!

Before the Make Debut, Tanino Gimlet
had by far the higher reputation.
And yet—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!
The revolution is fulfilled at last~~~!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Behold! Be amazed, everyone!
Only those who have secretly honed their blades in the shadows—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I shall achieve a wondrous feat of arms!
The Satsuki helmet belongs to none other than me!!
(Oooooo...)

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san, congratulations!
Everyone was completely taken aback, utterly bewitched...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: What do you think was the reason behind today's victory?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmph, that goes without saying.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for reasons!
Winners are always right, so anything goes~~!!

At first glance, it seems completely impromptu.
However...
choice_data_list: That was an incredible run, huh.
That was an incredible run, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: You chose the best line entirely on intuition...

text_block_list.text:
It might have looked like she was running without a plan,
but I know better.

Guided by wild instinct, No Reason
ran along the course with the least amount of wasted movement.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed.
I have watched many a Satsuki Sho, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Perhaps, for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah......
For the first time today—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I witnessed running that surpassed even my own victory.

A run acknowledged even by the great Narita Brian.
Today's No Reason was, without a doubt,
at his absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: She's strong, no doubt about it. But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: She too is... a rogue of the wind.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, the wind simply—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It merely blows through, leaving nothing behind.
That is simply the way of things.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lord Gimlet, wait!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There is no longer any need to hold my breath.
With pride—I shall proclaim my name.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I am No Reason! The one who shall strike down you, the strongest of our generation. And furthermore――

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"I shall be a great warlord who turns future generations upside down!
Bwahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ha, a warlord of the East.
Raising high—the shifting tides of fate?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, try and overturn it.
This geocentric celestial hemisphere."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed!
Our next battlefield is the second leg of the Classic Triple Crown,
the "Japanese Derby."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In a manner of speaking, this is our Sekigahara!
Let us eat our fill, sleep soundly, and prepare for battle.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, the 'Japanese Derby', is it?
However, that won't be the second, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The third banquet. For me, walking the Via Dolorosa,
there is a different banquet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Go on ahead and wait—
at the bottom of the valley of lamentation.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Have you gone mad, Gimlet...?
The Japanese Derby is the second leg, not the third...
Yet that night—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh, then let us descend.
Into the space between heaven and earth. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The NHK Mile Cup! A banquet of miles sandwiched right between the Satsuki Sho and the Tokyo Yushun!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
Whaaaat the heeeellâ?!

"The NHK Mile Cup...
A 1,600m Classic-class exclusive GⅠ held right before the Japanese Derby..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Running three Gâ  races between April and May...?
That's sheer madness...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufufu...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Now that was a good one!
You completely caught this No Reason off guard!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Do you really have that much confidence?
That even on such a grueling march,
you can beat me in the Nippon Derby!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What sheer ambition, what a colossal fool.
Wouldn't you agree, Trainer?

Running in the Satsuki Sho, NHK Mile Cup, and Japanese Derby all together...
would put an unbelievable strain on your body...
Just thinking of trying it is completely insane, and if you actually pulled it off, it'd be nothing short of a miracle.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Lord Gimlet, she too is unmistakably a daring maverick born into these turbulent times...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Truly like the elusive "Demon King of the Sixth Heaven"!
Let us bear witness to their fight.
And thenâ

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let us cross blades once more at the Japan Derby.
Just you and me in a one-on-one duel!

The Nippon Derby is almost certainly going to be
a head-to-head clash between the top two, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Somehow—will I make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby.
I have a duty—and a debt of gratitude.

—A third faction.
There might still be a dark horse lurking somewhere.
An unfamiliar newcomer warlord, watching vigilantly for a chance at the Nippon Derby.
